defs.def: impressive and large or important 壮丽的；堂皇的；重大的

ex.s: The Grand Canyon was not just big.
ex.t: 大峡谷不仅仅是巨大的。

ex.s: 3 Grand Prizes：Trip to Washington, D.C. for each of three winners, a parent and one other person of the winner’s choice.
ex.t: 3个大奖：三位获奖者各得一次华盛顿特区之旅，可带一名家长及获奖者选择的另一人。

ex.s: How many people can each grand prize winner take on the free trip? （    ）
ex.t: 每位大奖获得者可以带多少人参加免费旅行？（    ）

ex.s: Tourists can stand on a narrow glass platform called the Skywalk to see the Grand Canyon.
ex.t: 游客可以站在一个叫空中走廊的狭窄玻璃平台上观看大峡谷。

ex.s: Joachim: When was 15 years old, my mother bought me a copy of the classic Shi Ji, or Records of the Grand Historian.
ex.t: Joachim ： 15岁的时候，妈妈给我买了一本经典的《史记》。

ex.s: Their designs were admirable, varying from grand buildings to public works, such as roads and dams.
ex.t: 他们的设计令人赞叹，从宏伟建筑到道路、水坝等公共工程，各不相同。

defs.def: needing a lot of effort, money or time to succeed but intended to achieve impressive results 宏大的；宏伟的；有气派的
behaving in a proud way because they are rich or from a high social class 人
very good or enjoyable; excellent 极好的；快乐的；美妙的；出色的

ex.s: Tickets for the 2017 Grand Chinese New Year Concert in St Petersburg sold out, with 90% of the audience local Russians.
ex.t: 2017年圣彼得堡中国新年音乐会的门票售罄， 90%的观众是俄罗斯当地人。
